purpose: Honor document default tabs in ordinary left-aligned unshaped paragraphs and preserve inline rendering across tab pieces.
scope: Non-TOC, left aligned, text_shaping=False; same native inner margin fix applies to existing explicit tab helper.
limitations: Ordinary shaped/non-left paragraphs still collapse tabs; this is not complete Word tab layout.
Explicit alignment still measures the following text in the same run; multi-run tab fields remain incomplete.
Out-of-line default stops preserve visible text using native write wrapping, not verified as exact Word wrapping.
No performance benchmark, native Word/Windows or complete PDF/UA validation.

from docx.oxml.ns import qn
from docx.shared import Pt
from aspose.words_foss.libreoffice import convert_to_pdf
import pymupdf
root=Path('/tmp/docweave-default-tabs-native');root.mkdir(exist_ok=True);records={}
for step in (36,54):
 for count in (1,2):
  doc=Document();s=doc.sections[0];s.page_width=Pt(300);s.page_height=Pt(180);s.left_margin=s.right_margin=s.top_margin=s.bottom_margin=Pt(20)
  el=doc.settings.element.find(qn('w:defaultTabStop'))
  if el is None:el=OxmlElement('w:defaultTabStop');doc.settings.element.append(el)
  el.set(qn('w:val'),str(step*20))
  p=doc.add_paragraph();p.paragraph_format.left_indent=Pt(12);p.add_run('\t'*count+'RIGHT').font.size=Pt(11)
  source=root/f'{step}-{count}.docx';doc.save(source);out=source.with_suffix('.pdf');convert_to_pdf(source,out)
  with pymupdf.open(out) as pdf:
   words=pdf[0].get_text('words');word=next(w for w in words if w[4]=='RIGHT');assert abs(word[0]-(20+step*count))<.2
   pdf[0].get_pixmap(matrix=pymupdf.Matrix(3,3)).save(source.with_suffix('.png'))
   records[f'{step}-{count}']={'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'pdf_sha256':hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'words':words,'glyph_start_pt':word[0],'expected_start_pt':20+step*count,'pages':len(pdf)}

 for kind in ('toc','gap'):
